verses.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਰਨ ਘਟਾ ਘਮੰਡ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਿਰਾਜਮਾਨ ਬਰਖਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baran baran bahu baran ghaTaa ghama(n)dd basudhaa biraajamaan barakhaa ana(n)dh kai ||

en.bdb: The gathering of thick and different hue of clouds in the sky causes rain that beautifies the Earth spreading happiness all around.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਹੁਇ ਪ੍ਰਫੁਲਿਤ ਬਨਾਸਪਤੀ ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਮੂਲ ਕੰਦ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baran baran hui prafulit banaasapatee baran baran fal fool mool ka(n)dh kai ||

en.bdb: That also causes colourful flowers to bloom. The vegetation wears a fresh and new look.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਖਗ ਬਿਬਿਧ ਭਾਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਕੁਸਮ ਸੁਗੰਧ ਪਉਨ ਗਉਨ ਸੀਤ ਮੰਦ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baran baran khag bibidh bhaakhaa pragaas kusam suga(n)dh paun gaun seet ma(n)dh kai ||

en.bdb: With fragrance of the colourful flowers carried by cool breeze and fruits of different shape, size and taste, birds of various species come and sing songs merrily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਵਨ ਗਵਨ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਤ੍ਰਿਨ ਸੋਭਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਕੈ ॥੭੪॥
verses.translit_en: ravan gavan jal thal tiran sobhaa nidh safal hui charan kamal makara(n)dh kai ||74||

en.bdb: Enjoying all these attractions of the rainy season become more fruitful and enjoyable by putting hard work on the meditation of Lord's name as is advised by Satguru. (74)
